name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: Path to the agents directory
        required: false
        default: .continue/agents
        type: string
    secrets:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.list.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: List agent files
        id: list
        run: |
          echo "Searching for agent files in ${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          AGENTS=$(find "${{ inputs.agents-path }}" -type f -name '*.md' -printf '%p\n')
          if [ -z "$AGENTS" ]; then
            echo "No agent files found."
            echo "agents=[]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "$AGENTS" | jq -R . | jq -s . > /tmp/agents.json
            cat /tmp/agents.json >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
        shell: bash

  run_agents:
    needs: discover
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover.outputs.agents) }}
      fail-fast: false
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Continue CLI
        run: npm install -g @continue/cli

      - name: Run agent
        id: run
        run: |
          echo "Running agent ${{ matrix.agent }}"
          set -o pipefail
          continue agent run "${{ matrix.agent }}" > agent_output.txt 2>&1
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "Exit code: $EXIT_CODE" >> agent_output.txt
          echo "## Agent Output" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat agent_output.txt >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "output=$(base64 -w0 agent_output.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "success=$EXIT_CODE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Create Check Run
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const agentName = '${{ matrix.agent }}';
            const output = Buffer.from('${{ steps.run.outputs.output }}', 'base64').toString('utf8');
            const conclusion = '${{ steps.run.outputs.success }}' === '0' ? 'success' : 'failure';
            await github.checks.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              name: `Agent: ${agentName}`,
              head_sha: context.sha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion: conclusion,
              output: {
                title: `Agent ${agentName} ${conclusion}`,
                summary: output,
                text: output
              }
            });
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Fail job if agent failed
        if: ${{ steps.run.outputs.success != '0' }}
        run: exit 1
